title: HR500-AFG-82S
brief: Full Gigabit industrial PoE switch, 8*PoE ports and 2*SFP slots, with high flexibility and strong anti-interference ability, it is suitable for network engineering projects,such as road transportation, electric energy, miner metallurgy, comprehensive pipe gallery, automatic production and other industries.
parameter:

• Supports 8 *1000Mbps PoE ports+2* 1000Mbps SFP ports
• IEEE802.3af/at protocol standard, with a maximum single port PoE power of 30W
• DC48V~55V input, overvoltage and overload protection against reverse connection
• 4PIN Industrial terminals, dual redundant power supply
• Iron housing, IP40 Defense

• S6KV lightning protection, 15KV anti-static protection
• Operating temperature range -40 to +75℃
• DIN35 rail/wall mounting installation
